// MODULE_REGISTRATION.txt — Reserve Fund & Extraordinary Levies (Αποθεματικό)
// =============================================================================
// Do NOT edit schema.prisma or app.module.ts directly per task instructions.
// Merge these imports manually (or via the main agent).
// =============================================================================

1) In apps/api/src/app/app.module.ts:
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   import { ReserveModule } from '../reserve/reserve.module';
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Add to the `imports: [ ... ]` array (keep alphabetical-ish near PayoutsModule):
   ------------------------------------------------------------
     ComplianceModule,
     BudgetsModule,
     TransferModule,
     PayoutsModule,
     TreasuryModule,
     ReserveModule,   // <-- add this
     ExcelImportModule,
   ------------------------------------------------------------

2) No additional providers, guards, or global pipes required.
   - ReserveModule already imports AuditModule.
   - JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard are applied per-controller (ADMIN only).
   - Global ThrottlerGuard is registered in AuthModule (app-wide) — reserve routes
     automatically inherit throttling; no extra ThrottlerModule import needed.
   - ValidationPipe is applied per-controller with { whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true }.

3) After merging the Prisma fragment:
     pnpm prisma generate
     pnpm prisma migrate dev --name reserve

4) ReserveFund is per-building (buildingId @unique). getOrCreateFund is idempotent;
   drawing more than balance returns 400 BadRequest ('Insufficient reserve balance').
   Levy lifecycle: DRAFT -> ISSUED -> CLOSED. Issuing increments fund balance atomically and creates
   per-share ReserveContribution rows with source=LEVY.
